Sixty four bit queue pointers and shared memory extents use paired low and high registers. Selector registers choose which feature bank queue or memory region the companion register reaches. Generation changes across configuration updates and device specific space follows it.

Filesystem tag spans 36 bytes as UTF eight padded with zeros. Input string and bitmap selections each span 128 bytes. Block console and filesystem configuration areas have no implicit padding. Widths and endian forms stay as named in each layout.
